name: 40175 · Vine Grove, KY
findings: ZIP 40175 (Vine Grove) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (58% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40175 (Vine Grove) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 40175 (Vine Grove) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.
